summary: Civilian Conservation Corps steel tower erected at Mamers, Harnett County, in September 1934; no source read says whether it still stands.

facts.design: 72-foot 9-inch steel tower with a two-room tower house
facts.agency: North Carolina Division of Forest Resources

events.note: Erected by the Civilian Conservation Corps; cost of $990.63 covered by the Emergency Conservation Works program, no state money

evidence.supports: built September 1934 by CCC: 72-foot 9-inch steel tower and 2-room tower house
evidence.quote: September 1934: The Civilian Conservation Corps erected a 72-foot 9-inch steel tower and a 2-room tower house for a cost of $990.63.

evidence.supports: Emergency Conservation Works program covered costs, no state money
evidence.quote: The Emergency Conservation Works program covered the costs of the project with no money coming from the state.

evidence.supports: listing pairs Harnett County tower with NC Division of Forest Resources
evidence.quote: Harnett County - North Carolina Division of Forest Resources

evidence.supports: CCC built 52 new fire towers in NC, 1933-38
evidence.quote: Between 1933 and 1938, the Civilian Conservation Corps helped build 52 new fire towers

evidence.supports: state's first fire tower built in Harnett County in 1926, site not named
evidence.quote: In 1926, the state constructed its first fire tower, in Harnett County.

sources.title: Inventory of the North Carolina Forest Service Photograph Collection, 1913 - 1947

notes_for_editor: Only one lookout-specific source (the Eastern US Lookouts NC page), with the 1934 build date and design; no status, staffing or access found. A Facebook post (Legeros Fire Line) seen only as a search snippet lists a 'Harnett County Mamers Fire Tower ... Removed'. It could not be opened or quoted, so it is not in the story; worth checking before publishing. The 72-foot 9-inch figure is the tower height in the listing; the source does not say whether it runs to the cab floor, so height_m may need a check. The 1926 Harnett County tower is not tied to Mamers. The NC page carries a Mamers photo (uploads/1/5/9/1/1591048/5655522_orig.png) with no licence; not added. No individual Mamers page exists on easternuslookouts.weebly.com (404).
